label: Isotropic linear elasticity (Hooke)
text: EN.O.A1.3.2 Isotropic linear elasticity (Hooke). For small strain, a linear, isotropic material: σ = λ tr(ε) I + 2μ ε, with G = E / 2(1+ν). Uses PH.O.A1.5.
